description: Source code for the MacroExpander class, implementing macro expansion logic in a preprocessor, including token lexing, macro push/pop, argument collection, and macro expansion.

classes.name: TokenLexer
classes.description: A lexer that tokenizes a vector of tokens for macro expansion.

classes.name: MacroExpander::ScopedMacroReenabler
classes.description: A RAII class that temporarily disables macro re-enabling during macro argument collection.

classes.name: MacroExpander::MacroContext
classes.description: Represents a macro expansion context with token replacements and current index.

methods.name: MacroExpander::lex
methods.description: Fetches the next token, handling macro expansion and special tokens.

methods.name: MacroExpander::getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the next token, considering macro contexts and reserve tokens.

methods.name: MacroExpander::ungetToken
methods.description: Pushes back a token into the token stream or macro context.

methods.name: MacroExpander::pushMacro
methods.description: Begins macro expansion by pushing a macro onto the context stack.

methods.name: MacroExpander::popMacro
methods.description: Ends macro expansion by popping the macro context.

methods.name: MacroExpander::expandMacro
methods.description: Expands a macro into a list of tokens, handling object-like and function-like macros.

methods.name: MacroExpander::collectMacroArgs
methods.description: Collects macro arguments from tokens, handling nested parentheses and validation.

methods.name: MacroExpander::replaceMacroParams
methods.description: Replaces macro parameters in macro replacements with actual arguments.
